`final class FrameBuffer`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.render.framebuffer` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FrameBuffer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/render/framebuffer/FrameBuffer.java)

An offscreen image that you draw into once and then draw as many times as you want.

## Description

Fill it with your own drawing, then draw it where you need it; it keeps its content until you fill it again ([Draw once, reuse every frame](/use/learn/going-further/framebuffers-and-models/#draw-once-reuse-every-frame)).

A framebuffer holds GPU memory: create it on the render thread and call `delete()` when you are done with it.

## Creation details

<a id="FrameBuffer-factory-create"></a>

### create

`FrameBuffer create(int width, int height, TextureFilter filter)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates a framebuffer of `width` × `height` screen pixels, drawn later with the filter `filter`.
Its content is undefined until the first `fill`.

## Method details

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-delete"></a>

### delete

`void delete()` 

Frees the GPU memory of the framebuffer; do not use it afterwards.

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-fill"></a>

### fill

`this fill(Runnable runnable)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Runs `runnable` into the framebuffer, with one unit per pixel and `(0, 0)` at its top-left corner.
It does not clear the framebuffer first: clear it in `runnable` when you redraw over an earlier content.

`this fill(double x, double y, double width, double height, Runnable runnable)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Runs `runnable` into the framebuffer, with the area at `x`, `y` of `width` × `height` stretched over the whole framebuffer, so that you draw in the coordinates of that area.

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-draw"></a>

### draw

`this draw(double x, double y, double width, double height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalStateException`: The framebuffer of …x… is empty, call fill(...) before draw(...)

Draws the content at `x`, `y`, stretched to `width` × `height`, with premultiplied blending.
Throws `IllegalStateException` before the first `fill`.

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-getWidth"></a>

### getWidth

`int getWidth()`

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-getHeight"></a>

### getHeight

`int getHeight()`

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-getHandle"></a>

### getHandle

`IFrameBuffer getHandle()` 

Returns the framebuffer of the render bridge, for drawing it yourself with [`DrawResource.drawTexture`](/reference/drawing/drawresource/#DrawResource-method-drawTexture).

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-getFilter"></a>

### getFilter

`TextureFilter getFilter()` 

Returns the filter used when the framebuffer is drawn.

<a id="FrameBuffer-method-isFilled"></a>

### isFilled

`boolean isFilled()` 

If `true`, the framebuffer has been filled at least once and can be drawn.
